question: Can a fixed colour-blind content descriptor select one useful AO6 case on held camera groups, recovering material BM1 Oracle value without using source colour statistics, target pixels, operator signatures or dense blending?

feature_model.input: source luma replicated to RGB after fixed resize and center crop
feature_model.feature: L2-normalized mean of fixed DINOv2-S patch tokens

selector.rule: hard Top-1 cosine-nearest development source; ties by source_id
selector.ood_threshold: development-only 10th percentile of leave-one-development-source-out nearest cosine similarity
selector.ood_fallback: fold global operator medoid from BM1

controls.strength_oracle: exact BM1 analytically bounded scalar-strength control
controls.case_oracle: exact BM1 post-hoc hard case upper bound
controls.prior_negative_baseline: U5.R2BL10 colour-blind DINO hard selector closed on a different two-arm preference question

branches.pass: freeze this simplest hard selector and acquire a genuinely fresh unchanged confirmation population before any product consideration
branches.retrieval_fail: retain BM1 as descriptive Oracle evidence but close content routing; keep contextual AO6/global fallback
branches.shuffle_fail: treat apparent retrieval value as chance on this small population and close without embedding or threshold tuning
branches.tail_or_artifact_fail: close the selector without dense blending, score rescue or relaxed fallback

claim_ceiling: group-held development evidence for colour-blind hard content retrieval among deterministic AO6 Look Approximation cases; not film, stock, latent mode, calibration, authenticity, population preference, final-RGB ML or product promotion
